question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Explanation of the word "wealth" with its English and Hindi meanings:

 
 
• **Wealth:** A large amount or number of something. (प्रचुरता/धन)
 
• **Example:** She has a **wealth **of experience in the tech industry.
 
 
 
• Explanation of the word "supported" with its English and Hindi meanings:
 
 
• **Supported:** To hold up or serve as a foundation for something. (समर्थित)
 
• **Example:** His claims were **supported **by ample evidence.
 
 
 
• In context,** "a wealth of observational evidence" **means a large amount of data and findings that back up the Big Bang theory.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **wealth**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rich** (समृद्ध): Having abundant possessions and material wealth.

 
 
• **Example:** The country is rich in natural resources.
 
 
 
• **Store** (भंडार): A place where goods are kept for future use.
 
 
• **Example:** We have a store of food for the winter months.
 
 
 
• **Debt** (ऋण): Something owed, usually money.
 
 
• **Example:** He is still paying off his student debt.
